name: The Fool
meaning_upright: A young traveler in colorful medieval dress steps gaily forward. New beginnings, carefree spirit, trust in the universe.
meaning_reversed: Recklessness, foolishness, naivety, ignoring warnings.

name: The Magician
meaning_upright: A Renaissance magus at a table bearing all four suits. Skill, focused will, resourcefulness, manifestation.
meaning_reversed: Manipulation, trickery, untapped potential, lack of focus.

name: The High Priestess
meaning_upright: A serene priestess between two pillars holding a scroll. Intuition, sacred mystery, hidden knowledge, the subconscious.
meaning_reversed: Surface living, hidden agendas, secrets withheld, disconnection.

name: The Empress
meaning_upright: A fertile queen surrounded by abundant nature. Nurturing, creativity, abundance, the Earth Mother.
meaning_reversed: Creative block, dependence, smothering, barrenness.

name: The Emperor
meaning_upright: A powerful ruler on a stone throne in full regalia. Authority, structure, stability, protection.
meaning_reversed: Tyranny, rigidity, over-control, abuse of power.

name: The Hierophant
meaning_upright: A pontifical figure flanked by pillars, hands raised in blessing. Spiritual tradition, community wisdom, sacred institutions.
meaning_reversed: Dogma, conformity, rejecting tradition, unconventional paths.

name: The Lovers
meaning_upright: Two figures beneath an angel's blessing in a garden. Union, choice, aligned values, sacred partnership.
meaning_reversed: Disharmony, poor choices, misaligned values, inner conflict.

name: The Chariot
meaning_upright: A triumphant charioteer drawn by sphinxes. Victory, willpower, controlled movement, determination.
meaning_reversed: Defeat, aggression, scattered force, loss of direction.

name: Strength
meaning_upright: A woman gently closing a lion's jaws. Inner strength, compassion over force, patience, courage.
meaning_reversed: Self-doubt, weakness, raw emotion, inner conflict.

name: The Hermit
meaning_upright: A cloaked elder with a lantern on a snowy mountain. Introspection, solitude, inner guidance, withdrawal.
meaning_reversed: Excessive isolation, loneliness, withdrawal, missing connection.

name: Wheel of Fortune
meaning_upright: A great wheel with symbolic creatures, destiny spinning. Fate, cycles, turning points, lucky change.
meaning_reversed: Misfortune, resisting cycles, clinging to the past.

name: Justice
meaning_upright: A robed figure with sword and scales, seated between pillars. Truth, fairness, accountability, karmic balance.
meaning_reversed: Injustice, bias, dishonesty, imbalance.

name: The Hanged Man
meaning_upright: A youth suspended peacefully upside-down from a cross. Voluntary surrender, new perspective, sacrifice, illumination.
meaning_reversed: Stubbornness, wasted sacrifice, stalling, resistance.

name: Death
meaning_upright: A skeleton knight on horseback, the sun rising beyond. Endings, transformation, necessary change, passage.
meaning_reversed: Stagnation, resistance to change, fear of endings.

name: Temperance
meaning_upright: An angel pouring water between two cups in a radiant landscape. Balance, moderation, healing, patience.
meaning_reversed: Excess, imbalance, lack of harmony, impatience.

name: The Devil
meaning_upright: A goat-headed figure enthroning two chained figures. Bondage, materialism, shadow self, unhealthy attachments.
meaning_reversed: Breaking free, releasing addiction, reclaiming power, detachment.

name: The Tower
meaning_upright: A tower struck by lightning, figures falling. Sudden upheaval, chaos, revelation, destruction of false foundations.
meaning_reversed: Averting disaster, fear of change, postponed reckoning.

name: The Star
meaning_upright: A kneeling figure pouring water under a great eight-pointed star. Hope, renewal, inspiration, healing.
meaning_reversed: Despair, lost faith, discouragement, loss of hope.

name: The Moon
meaning_upright: A moon shining over twin towers, a crayfish emerging. Illusion, subconscious, psychic depth, uncertainty.
meaning_reversed: Clarity emerging, dispelling illusions, releasing fear.

name: The Sun
meaning_upright: A child on horseback in a sunlit garden bearing a banner. Joy, success, vitality, clarity, radiant living.
meaning_reversed: Blocked joy, overconfidence, delays, inner child wound.

name: Judgement
meaning_upright: An angel blowing a trumpet, figures rising. Awakening, inner calling, absolution, rebirth.
meaning_reversed: Self-doubt, ignoring the call, fear of judgment, stagnation.

name: The World
meaning_upright: A dancing figure within a laurel wreath, four symbols in corners. Completion, wholeness, integration, fulfillment.
meaning_reversed: Incompletion, loose ends, avoiding closure, stagnation.

name: Ace of Wands
meaning_upright: Ace of Wands card. A new creative spark, inspired beginning, untapped potential, pure fire of initiative.
meaning_reversed: Blocked inspiration, missed opportunities, delays in starting, lack of motivation.

name: Two of Wands
meaning_upright: Two of Wands card. Planning and vision; standing at a crossroads, mapping the journey ahead, personal power.
meaning_reversed: Poor planning, impatience, not seeing the big picture, fear of change.

name: Three of Wands
meaning_upright: Three of Wands card. Expansion and foresight; looking ahead with confidence, early success, exploring horizons.
meaning_reversed: Delays, lack of foresight, obstacles to growth, arrogance.

name: Four of Wands
meaning_upright: Four of Wands card. Celebration and community; homecoming, harmony, foundation built, festive rest.
meaning_reversed: Lack of harmony, cancelled celebration, instability in foundations.

name: Five of Wands
meaning_upright: Five of Wands card. Conflict and competition; creative tension, rivalry, learning through challenge.
meaning_reversed: Avoiding conflict, unnecessary arguments, aggression, lack of challenge.

name: Six of Wands
meaning_upright: Six of Wands card. Victory and public recognition; success acknowledged, leadership, overcoming obstacles.
meaning_reversed: Delayed success, fall from grace, arrogance, failed recognition.

name: Seven of Wands
meaning_upright: Seven of Wands card. Courage under pressure; standing your ground, defensive strength, perseverance.
meaning_reversed: Giving up, running away, overwhelming odds, losing ground.

name: Eight of Wands
meaning_upright: Eight of Wands card. Swift action and movement; fast developments, momentum, messages traveling quickly.
meaning_reversed: Delays, frustration, canceled plans, resisting necessary speed.

name: Nine of Wands
meaning_upright: Nine of Wands card. Resilience and persistence; wounded but holding on, inner reserves, preparedness.
meaning_reversed: Paranoia, stubbornness, not healing from wounds, defensive excess.

name: Ten of Wands
meaning_upright: Ten of Wands card. Burden and completion; the weight of accumulated responsibilities, near the finish.
meaning_reversed: Carrying too much, inability to delegate, near collapse, oppressive burden.

name: Page of Wands
meaning_upright: Page of Wands card. Curiosity and enthusiasm; a beginner's energy, fresh perspectives, eager learning.
meaning_reversed: Creative blocks, scattered energy, immaturity, undeveloped ideas.

name: Knight of Wands
meaning_upright: Knight of Wands card. Passionate action; bold advance, impulsive drive, adventurous spirit, courage.
meaning_reversed: Recklessness, impatience, haste making waste, scattered fire.

name: Queen of Wands
meaning_upright: Queen of Wands card. Confidence and authority; natural leadership, magnetic presence, creativity in command.
meaning_reversed: Bossy, volatile, demanding, using power poorly, creative drought.

name: King of Wands
meaning_upright: King of Wands card. Mastery and vision; inspired authority, bold vision, the fire that guides others.
meaning_reversed: Arrogance, impulsiveness, ruthlessness, using fire to burn others.

name: Ace of Cups
meaning_upright: Ace of Cups card. New emotional beginning, overflowing love, opening the heart, spiritual gift.
meaning_reversed: Blocked emotions, closed heart, missed spiritual opportunity, emotional immaturity.

name: Two of Cups
meaning_upright: Two of Cups card. Partnership and mutual feeling; connection, attraction, coming together in love.
meaning_reversed: Imbalance in relationship, codependency, crossed signals, bad communication.

name: Three of Cups
meaning_upright: Three of Cups card. Celebration and friendship; joy shared among community, abundance of feeling.
meaning_reversed: Overindulgence, cancelled celebration, isolation, jealousy among friends.

name: Four of Cups
meaning_upright: Four of Cups card. Contemplation; stillness, introspection, boredom with what is offered, inner restlessness.
meaning_reversed: Emotional withdrawal, missing what's in front of you, boredom, depression.

name: Five of Cups
meaning_upright: Five of Cups card. Loss and grief; mourning what was, regret, focusing on what is gone.
meaning_reversed: Acceptance and moving on, focusing on what remains, releasing grief.

name: Six of Cups
meaning_upright: Six of Cups card. Nostalgia and kindness; childhood memories, innocence, generosity, simple joy.
meaning_reversed: Living in the past, naivety, unresolved childhood issues, lost innocence.

name: Seven of Cups
meaning_upright: Seven of Cups card. Fantasy and wishful thinking; many possibilities, temptation, dreams awaiting discernment.
meaning_reversed: Clarity about illusions, temptation resisted, facing reality, disillusion.

name: Eight of Cups
meaning_upright: Eight of Cups card. Moving on with purpose; leaving behind the comfortable to seek something greater.
meaning_reversed: Fear of moving on, staying in a comfort zone, unable to let go.

name: Nine of Cups
meaning_upright: Nine of Cups card. Contentment and satisfaction; wishes fulfilled, emotional abundance, quiet happiness.
meaning_reversed: Materialism, greed, smug self-satisfaction, unhappiness with abundance.

name: Ten of Cups
meaning_upright: Ten of Cups card. Emotional fulfillment; family bliss, community joy, long-term happiness, love.
meaning_reversed: Broken home, conflict within family, misaligned values, joyless community.

name: Page of Cups
meaning_upright: Page of Cups card. Sensitivity and new emotional awareness; curiosity of the heart, messages from the intuitive.
meaning_reversed: Emotional immaturity, false visions, unreliable intuition, escapism.

name: Knight of Cups
meaning_upright: Knight of Cups card. Romance and intuition; following the heart, dreamy pursuit, emotional quest.
meaning_reversed: Moodiness, poor emotional decisions, jealousy, romantic disappointment.

name: Queen of Cups
meaning_upright: Queen of Cups card. Emotional depth and nurturing; the caring heart, intuitive wisdom, compassionate leadership.
meaning_reversed: Moodiness, emotional manipulation, self-pity, smothering love.

name: King of Cups
meaning_upright: King of Cups card. Emotional mastery and wisdom; calm authority over feeling, healing presence, deep compassion.
meaning_reversed: Emotional coldness, manipulation, unresolved wounds, abuse of empathy.

name: Ace of Swords
meaning_upright: Ace of Swords card. Mental clarity and breakthrough; truth cutting through confusion, the sword of discernment.
meaning_reversed: Mental confusion, clouded thinking, poor decisions, misused truth.

name: Two of Swords
meaning_upright: Two of Swords card. Difficult choice; stalemate, avoidance, temporary peace through willful blindness.
meaning_reversed: Indecision, information overload, stalemate broken badly, forced choice.

name: Three of Swords
meaning_upright: Three of Swords card. Heartbreak and sorrow; grief, betrayal, necessary pain that opens the heart.
meaning_reversed: Healing from heartbreak, releasing pain, forgiveness, mending.

name: Four of Swords
meaning_upright: Four of Swords card. Rest and recovery; retreat, convalescence, peaceful contemplation after conflict.
meaning_reversed: Restlessness, inability to rest, recovery avoided, stagnation.

name: Five of Swords
meaning_upright: Five of Swords card. Defeat and loss; hollow victory, conflict with lasting damage, humiliation.
meaning_reversed: Recovery from conflict, cutting losses, reconciliation, moving past defeat.

name: Six of Swords
meaning_upright: Six of Swords card. Transition and passage; moving through difficulty, guided crossing, journey.
meaning_reversed: Stuck in the past, refusal to move on, resistance to guidance.

name: Seven of Swords
meaning_upright: Seven of Swords card. Deception and cunning; strategy, theft of ideas, getting away with something.
meaning_reversed: Conscience, facing deception, caught in a lie, reconsideration.

name: Eight of Swords
meaning_upright: Eight of Swords card. Restriction and self-limiting beliefs; feeling trapped, mind as prison, victim thinking.
meaning_reversed: Freedom from self-limiting beliefs, release from restriction, emerging.

name: Nine of Swords
meaning_upright: Nine of Swords card. Anxiety and nightmares; fear spiraling in the dark, worry, mental anguish.
meaning_reversed: Shame and despair released, slowly healing, worries diminishing.

name: Ten of Swords
meaning_upright: Ten of Swords card. Ending and crisis; the nadir, rock bottom, painful conclusion, surrender to truth.
meaning_reversed: Recovery from crisis, survival, the darkest night passing, rising again.

name: Page of Swords
meaning_upright: Page of Swords card. Intellectual curiosity; sharp mind, message received, new information, observant wit.
meaning_reversed: Scatteredness, gossip, impulsive talk, superficial curiosity, poor planning.

name: Knight of Swords
meaning_upright: Knight of Swords card. Swift intelligence; charging toward truth, decisive action, impatience for resolution.
meaning_reversed: Recklessness, scattered aggression, too much haste, destructive impulse.

name: Queen of Swords
meaning_upright: Queen of Swords card. Sharp discernment; clear judgment, honest assessment, decisive wisdom, perceptive authority.
meaning_reversed: Cruelty, cold judgment, harsh words used as weapons, cutting too deep.

name: King of Swords
meaning_upright: King of Swords card. Mental mastery; keen intellect, fair judgment, cool analysis, ethical clarity.
meaning_reversed: Cruelty, abuse of intellect, tyrannical coldness, manipulative logic.

name: Ace of Pentacles
meaning_upright: Ace of Pentacles card. Material opportunity, new financial beginning, manifestation of potential, gift of the earth.
meaning_reversed: Missed opportunities, poor financial decisions, lack of manifestation, squandered potential.

name: Two of Pentacles
meaning_upright: Two of Pentacles card. Adaptability and balance; juggling priorities, flexibility, managing resources.
meaning_reversed: Imbalance, disorganization, financial instability, inability to juggle demands.

name: Three of Pentacles
meaning_upright: Three of Pentacles card. Teamwork and skilled craftsmanship; collaboration, mastery through effort, recognized work.
meaning_reversed: Lack of teamwork, poor craftsmanship, unacknowledged work, creative blocks.

name: Four of Pentacles
meaning_upright: Four of Pentacles card. Financial security and conservation; holding onto resources, stability, but possible hoarding.
meaning_reversed: Materialism, greed, hoarding, financial obsession, fear of loss.

name: Five of Pentacles
meaning_upright: Five of Pentacles card. Material hardship; poverty, exclusion, asking for help, enduring difficulty.
meaning_reversed: Recovery from hardship, seeking support, charity accepted, isolation ending.

name: Six of Pentacles
meaning_upright: Six of Pentacles card. Generosity and sharing; giving and receiving, fair distribution, charity.
meaning_reversed: Greed, debt, selfishness, poor financial management, imbalanced giving.

name: Seven of Pentacles
meaning_upright: Seven of Pentacles card. Patience and assessment; taking stock of progress, long-term investment, waiting for harvest.
meaning_reversed: Impatience, poor investment, lack of foresight, abandoned projects.

name: Eight of Pentacles
meaning_upright: Eight of Pentacles card. Focused skill and improvement; diligence, craftsmanship, incremental mastery.
meaning_reversed: Perfectionism, poor quality, lack of focus, amateur effort.

name: Nine of Pentacles
meaning_upright: Nine of Pentacles card. Independence and material comfort; self-sufficiency, enjoying the fruits of labor.
meaning_reversed: Overwork, isolation, all work no play, financial security at cost of living.

name: Ten of Pentacles
meaning_upright: Ten of Pentacles card. Legacy and family prosperity; ancestral wealth, long-term security, generational roots.
meaning_reversed: Financial dysfunction, family debt, broken legacy, lost inheritance.

name: Page of Pentacles
meaning_upright: Page of Pentacles card. Practicality and learning; earthy curiosity, new skills, enthusiastic study of material world.
meaning_reversed: Immaturity with money, naivety, wasted learning, lazy approach.

name: Knight of Pentacles
meaning_upright: Knight of Pentacles card. Reliable effort; steadfast persistence, methodical approach, patient progress.
meaning_reversed: Stubbornness, laziness, dull persistence without progress.

name: Queen of Pentacles
meaning_upright: Queen of Pentacles card. Nurturing abundance; the fertile ground of care, generosity, practical wisdom.
meaning_reversed: Overprotective, smothering with money, financial control, neglect.

name: King of Pentacles
meaning_upright: King of Pentacles card. Material mastery; prosperity through patience, stable authority, practical leadership.
meaning_reversed: Corruption, greed, financial mismanagement, abuse of material power.
